correctness.rationale: For connected finite n>=2 diameter<=2, color 1 occupies an independent set I; every color >=2 is used at most once and broadcasts to all vertices. With r=n-|I| high-color singleton vertices, a k-block broadcasting partition exists iff r>=k, or r=k-1 and I is maximal independent (a nonempty rootless block must contain all I, leaving exactly k-1 blocks each containing a high-color vertex). The two cases are disjoint and yield sum_{r=k}^n i_{n-r}(t-1)_r + m_{n-k+1}(t-1)_{k-1}. Falling-factorial independence recovers all independent-set and maximal-independent-set cardinality distributions. The 3-case optimal palette/multiplicity formula follows from r>=n-alpha, high-color injection, and the exact r=k-1 boundary. Reviewed actual RESULT.md, verify_full.py and finite source data. Independent direct brute force on P3, K3, and a connected four-vertex diameter-two graph matched all predicted F_{k}(t) for t=1..n+1, 44 (graph,t,k) cases; archived checker asserts 1594 tests but logs alone were not treated as proof.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks cover only n=3,4; unrestricted conclusion rests on the combinatorial obstruction lemma, not sampling.
